source_note: Only attractions with an official-source hours or fee line are included. Blank cells are unverified. Social links (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram) are not yet verified for any activity and are left blank.

rows.name: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area (Scenic Drive)
rows.location: About 17 miles west of the Las Vegas Strip, on Charleston Blvd / SR 159 (BLM)
rows.hours: Timed-entry reservation required 8 a.m.–5 p.m., Oct 1–May 31 (BLM, 2020 release; confirm current season). Not required June 1–Sept 30.
rows.booking: Recreation.gov timed entry: https://www.recreation.gov/timed-entry/10075177 (linked from BLM release; not fetched)
rows.day_exceptions: BLM says it waived amenity fees for Presidents Day in 2021 (Feb 15). A 2027 waiver is not confirmed. Presidents' Day 2027 falls on Feb 15.
rows.flag: Fee and visitor-center hours not confirmed on an official page. Hours in the 2026 third-party guide ($20/car, visitor center 8–4:30) are not used.

rows.name: Valley of Fire State Park
rows.location: Nevada state park; Overton, NV (per park site)
rows.hours: Park open daily, sunrise to sunset. Visitor Center daily 9 a.m.–4 p.m. (park office Mon–Fri 9–4).
rows.fee: $10 per vehicle (Nevada plates); $15 per vehicle (non-Nevada plates). Camping: $20 per vehicle per night.
rows.day_exceptions: Visitor-center hours vary by source (a third-party 2026 page says 8:30–4:30). The official page is used.
rows.flag: Official page snippet is dated 2017 by the crawler. Confirm current hours and fees on parks.nv.gov before the trip. Distance from the Strip is not verified on an official page.

rows.name: Hoover Dam Visitor Center and Dam Tours
rows.location: About 30 miles southeast of Las Vegas on US 93 at the Nevada–Arizona border (usbr.gov, archived page)
rows.hours: Visitor Center open daily 9 a.m.–5 p.m., closed Thanksgiving and Christmas Day. Last tour departs 4:10 p.m. Dam area open daily 5 a.m.–9 p.m. PST.
rows.fee: Guided Dam Tour: $40 per person (children 3 and under free), on-site purchase only.
rows.booking: Tours are sold on-site per the official page. Unofficial resellers exist; the official page warns against unofficial sites.
rows.day_exceptions: Closed Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day (official). Not open on those days.
rows.flag: Tour booking-window claim (2–3 months) comes from an unofficial site and is not used. The 30-mile distance comes from an archived usbr.gov page; re-check on the current site.
